services.desc: For all ages! • 3 hours • FRONT ROW SEATS TO A SLEEPING GIANT

services.name: ICE CAVE EXPERIENCE
services.desc: For all ages! • 3 hours • EXPLORE THE ICE CAVE

services.name: LAKE LOVELY WATER CHARTERS
services.desc: Historic alpine hut at the outflow of Lake Lovely Water in Tantalus Provincial Park, offering hut and nearby tent camping in the Tantalus Range. For all ages! • 15 Minutes • EXPLORE THE LAKE LOVELY

services.name: JIM HABERL HUT CHARTERS
services.desc: Scenic mountaineering area featuring mixed snow and rock routes and the Jim Haberl Hut in the Tantalus Range near Squamish. For all ages! • 15 Minutes

services.name: SEA TO SKY OVERVIEW
services.desc: Approx. 1-hour scenic helicopter flight over Whistler Blackcomb, Cheakamus and Garibaldi lakes with a glacier landing. For all ages! • 57 minutes • Up to 5 people

services.name: GLACIER TOURS
services.desc: Scenic 14-minute helicopter flight over Wedgemount Lake and a flyaround of Wedge Mountain and glacier from about 8,000 feet. For all ages! • 14 minutes

services.name: SUMMIT TOURS
services.desc: A 24-minute scenic helicopter flyover of Whistler Blackcomb area featuring Cheakamus Lake, Garibaldi Lake and Black Tusk Peak. For all ages! • 24 minutes
